title: Single-Stage Weakly Supervised Segmentation with Localization Token and Memory Bank

nodes.label: Input Image
nodes.semantic_desc: Raw RGB training image used for weakly supervised semantic segmentation.
nodes.visual_desc: A natural image (e.g., street scene) thumbnail with no text, realistic colors.

nodes.label: Image-level Labels
nodes.semantic_desc: Multi-label class presence annotation at image level (no pixel masks).
nodes.visual_desc: A compact tag list / multi-hot vector visualization (e.g., small class icons or a 0/1 bar) without text inside.

nodes.label: Smaller Patch Tokenizer
nodes.semantic_desc: Patch embedding stage using smaller patch size to increase spatial granularity for pixel-level localization.
nodes.visual_desc: A rounded rectangle module labeled 'Smaller Patch Tokenizer' with a tiny grid icon indicating finer patches.

nodes.label: Localization Token
nodes.semantic_desc: A dedicated learnable token injected at the input/token level to strengthen localization cues under weak supervision.
nodes.visual_desc: A small pill-shaped token icon feeding into the encoder, labeled 'Loc Token'.

nodes.label: SegFormer Backbone
nodes.semantic_desc: Transformer encoder (SegFormer backbone) extracting multi-scale feature maps from tokens.
nodes.visual_desc: A large rounded rectangle labeled 'SegFormer Backbone' with stacked feature pyramid glyphs on the right edge.

nodes.label: Adapter Module
nodes.semantic_desc: Lightweight adaptation block to enhance feature discrimination/localization without full backbone retraining.
nodes.visual_desc: A slim rounded rectangle labeled 'Adapter' attached to the backbone output stream (sidecar style).

nodes.label: Classification Head
nodes.semantic_desc: Image-level classifier head producing class logits from backbone features for weak supervision.
nodes.visual_desc: A rounded rectangle labeled 'Cls Head' followed by a small logits vector icon.

nodes.label: Classification Loss
nodes.semantic_desc: Supervision term computed from image-level labels and classification logits (e.g., multi-label BCE/CE).
nodes.visual_desc: A small hexagon labeled 'L_cls' with an incoming label arrow and outgoing gradient arrow.

nodes.label: Segmentation Decoder
nodes.semantic_desc: Decoder head that upsamples and fuses backbone features to produce dense per-pixel logits.
nodes.visual_desc: A rounded rectangle labeled 'Decoder' with an upsampling arrow icon.

nodes.label: Predicted Segmentation
nodes.semantic_desc: Dense semantic segmentation prediction (per-pixel class map) generated by the decoder.
nodes.visual_desc: A color-coded segmentation mask overlay on the input image (distinct colors for classes), no text.

nodes.label: Patch Clustering
nodes.semantic_desc: Clustering over fine-grained patch features to form region/group cues for pseudo-label generation.
nodes.visual_desc: A rounded rectangle labeled 'Patch Clustering' with a scatter plot icon and colored cluster blobs.

nodes.label: Memory Bank
nodes.semantic_desc: Feature memory storing class/region prototypes or historical patch embeddings to stabilize pseudo labels.
nodes.visual_desc: A database cylinder icon labeled 'Memory Bank' with arrows indicating read/write.

nodes.label: Pseudo-label Generator
nodes.semantic_desc: Generates pixel-level pseudo masks by combining predictions with clustering and memory bank cues.
nodes.visual_desc: A rounded rectangle labeled 'Pseudo-label Generator' with a wand/gear icon and a mask output port.

nodes.label: Pseudo Labels
nodes.semantic_desc: Generated pixel-wise supervision signal used to train the segmentation branch under weak supervision.
nodes.visual_desc: A grayscale/colored mask image with crisp regions (pseudo mask look), no text.

nodes.label: Pixel-wise CE Loss
nodes.semantic_desc: Cross-entropy loss between predicted segmentation and pseudo labels for dense supervision.
nodes.visual_desc: A small hexagon labeled 'L_ce' with two inputs (pred mask, pseudo mask) and an output gradient arrow.

nodes.label: Total Loss
nodes.semantic_desc: Combined training objective aggregating classification and pixel-wise losses to optimize the model.
nodes.visual_desc: A summation node (circle with '+') labeled 'L = L_cls + L_ce' inside.
